shown_card_text.title: Weekly limits, two meters
shown_card_text.what: Claude and Codex weekly meters fill across one week, pause at the top and reset, with the pixel runner below and no real usage numbers. It is one of the core animations you asked for, built to be reused.
shown_card_text.why: You asked for more core animations we can reuse across episodes.
shown_card_text.question: What should happen to this animation?
shown_card_text.recommendation: Use it under any weekly limit talk, in episodes or Shorts.
context: Ten seconds, vertical, in the locked look, with no sound so it can sit under any voice.

visual_input_policy: The exact first existing still/poster shown on the source card. It is one frame, not full video or audio.
